name: toggle-group
title: Toggle Group
description: Manga-styled group of toggles (Base UI or Radix). By default (spacing 0) the toggles share one frame, split by a 2px line like the cells of a boxed Tabs; the pressed cell is an ink flat that sweeps in; hover thickens the line of a cell. With spacing above 0 each toggle is a framed button of its own. Orientation horizontal or vertical. Single and multiple selection come from the stock API (value / defaultValue arrays, multiple). Focus stays inside its cell. Gestures: G2 flat, G3 hover on cells, G4 impact.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/toggle-group". It wraps your own components/ui/toggle-group and the manga toggle look, so Radix and Base UI both work for the props they share (value, defaultValue, orientation, spacing, variant, size, disabled).

meta.tagline: Toggles joined in one frame; the pressed cell floods with ink.
meta.usage:
import { ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem } from "@/components/ui/manga/toggle-group"

<ToggleGroup aria-label="Alignment" defaultValue={["center"]}>
  <ToggleGroupItem value="left">Left</ToggleGroupItem>
  <ToggleGroupItem value="center">Centre</ToggleGroupItem>
  <ToggleGroupItem value="right">Right</ToggleGroupItem>
</ToggleGroup>

props.name: spacing
props.description: 0 (default): one joined frame. Above 0: separate framed toggles with that gap.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Row or column. The joined lines follow the orientation.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Stock Base UI option: several cells may be pressed at once.
